card.name: Opening letter of omeprazole and other drug names
card.fires_on: The first letter or two of a drug name written with a capital O (mainly Omeprazole) right after a verb or heading such as 'with', 'of', 'Restart' or 'Discontinue'. It also fires on a few other word starts like 'Th'.

modes.label: Omeprazole start
modes.description: The single letter O that begins Omeprazole in interaction and dosing text.

modes.description: The opening letter of other brand names or words after a verb or heading.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing a word start that needs continuing, such as 'pres' or 'cur', but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letter of a drug name, most often Omeprazole, before the rest of the name appears.
